Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. in_hebrew.name: נערה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: משמעות השם נערה מגיעה מעברית, ומהווה פרי של תפילה. השם נערה הוא תואר שמציין את גיל הנערה, ובמקרא, הוא מתייחס לבת שגילה נעורים. השם נערה הוא גם מושא להתייחסות בביטוי ערב אורי, שמשמעותו באב אורי, הל מורי. בבית המקדש, השם נערה היה נושא לשיר אהבה, המתאר את היופי והחן של הנערה. השם נערה נחשב לשם יפה ומוערך במזרח התיכון, והוא נמצא בשימוש נרחב בישראל ובארצות הברית.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Norah originates from the Hebrew root, meaning young woman or maiden. In the biblical context, the name Norah refers to a young woman in a state of innocence. In Christian tradition, the name Norah is used to signify a young woman in a state of innocence. The name Norah is also associated with the Latin word puella, meaning a young girl or maiden. In modern culture, the name Norah is popular due to its association with qualities such as innocence, purity, and youthful energy. The name Norah is often given to girls born into Christian families, as it is seen as a reflection of the values of the Christian faith.

This name reflects the belief that every person is a unique creation of God and is deserving of honor, respect, and love. historical_references.reference: According to Irish legend, Norah was the name of a legendary heroine who was a fairy queen and a healer. She was said to have lived in the ninth or tenth century and was the patroness of travellers and sick people. This name gained popularity in Ireland and was later spread to other parts of the English-speaking world through Irish immigration.

Saint Norreys (or Norah) was an early Christian martyr who died in the fourth century in the town of Norreys in Berkshire, England. She is believed to have been a slave and was tortured and beheaded for refusing to renounce her Christian faith. Her feast day is celebrated on March 16.
